title: MacroPulse Alert
message:
US Flash PMI Oct: Composite 57.6 (eased from 58.4); Mfg 56.0 beat, Services 57.9 slight miss. Selling prices at sharpest since Aug 2022 — stagflationary read supports Dec hike path.
Crypto: BTC ~$81,600 (−1.7% 24h); ~$600M in longs liquidated. Market consolidating ahead of Oct 27-28 FOMC (hold ~85% priced).
